# Aubio 0.4.9

Source: https://aubio.org/pub/aubio-0.4.9.tar.bz2 (matching PyPI aubio-0.4.9 source release).
License: GPL-3.0-or-later; full text in COPYING.

Unmodified upstream headers and C files needed by the streaming onset detector. Built without external FFT/audio-file dependencies, using upstream Ooura FFT. Configuration macros match the upstream Python Windows build. Host processes snapshots off the audio callback.
